pieces.Text: You empower your strike with elemental energy
When you use Elemental Strike, on a successful hit, the attack deals damage normally plus
points of acid damage. You must declare that you are using this feat before you make your attack roll (thus a failed attack roll ruins the attempt). You may attempt an elemental fist attack
times per day, but no more than once per round.
